Nothing here matches verdict-spec-persist.yaml's proposal — that absence is deliberate, so the §2 search cannot stop that run and the SPEC branch is exercised on its own merits. FIX-21 is a deliberate near-duplicate of verdict-spec.yaml's proposal; FIX-24 is a deliberate near-duplicate of verdict-stop.yaml's proposal, already recorded as a decision.
